name: rosetta-roman-numerals-decode
code:
use default

value(letter: char) -> int =>
    case letter
    when 'M' then 1000
    when 'D' then 500
    when 'C' then 100
    when 'L' then 50
    when 'X' then 10
    when 'V' then 5
    else 1
    esac

signed_value(numeral: string, index: int) -> int =>
    if index + 1 < numeral.length /\
        value(numeral[index]) < value(numeral[index + 1]) then
        -value(numeral[index])
    else
        value(numeral[index])
    fi

decode(numeral: string) -> int =>
    (0..numeral.length)
        |> map(index => signed_value(numeral, index))
        |> reduce(0, (total, part) => total + part)

for numeral in ["MCMXC", "MMVIII", "MDCLXVI"] do
    write_line("{numeral} = {decode(numeral)}")
od
